title: When x meets its square
question: How many answers can a quadratic equation have?
hook: Give an equation a squared term and the number of answers stops being obvious.
idea: A quadratic with real coefficients has zero, one or two real roots, and completing the square finds them.

beats.prompt: A quadratic equation has only one distinct root. How can that root be understood?

choices.label: As two roots that happen to have the same value
As a missing root, so the equation is really linear
choices.feedback: A double root is still a root, counted twice, not a missing one.

choices.label: As a root plus a hidden complex partner
choices.feedback: Complex roots come in a pair when there are no real roots, not alongside a real one.

choices.label: As a sign the equation is broken
choices.feedback: A single repeated root is allowed and has a name.

beats.explain: A single distinct root is a double root, two roots with the same value.

beats.prompt: Put the steps of completing the square in order.
items: Add the square of one-half of b/a, the coefficient of x, to both sides
See that the left side is now a perfect square
Write the left side as a square and simplify the right side
Take the positive and negative square roots to get two linear equations
beats.explain: Adding the right amount completes the square, then you write it as a square, then square roots give two linear equations.

beats.prompt: Match each name to what it is.
pairs: Gives the solutions in terms of a, b and c
One of several ways to derive that formula
Equation holds if px + q = 0 or rx + s = 0
Apart from special cases, needs rational roots
beats.explain: Each connects to finding the solutions of a quadratic equation, and each has its own use.

beats.prompt: One step in this reasoning is wrong. Which?
steps: To solve x² + 5x + 6 = 0, look for two numbers that add to 5 and multiply to 6.
Those numbers are 2 and 3, so it factors as (x + 2)(x + 3) = 0.
A product is zero only if one factor is zero, so x + 2 = 0 or x + 3 = 0.
So the solutions are x = 2 and x = 3.
beats.explain: Solving x + 2 = 0 and x + 3 = 0 gives x = −2 and x = −3, not the positive numbers.
